bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · slipping under the 30-day
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 跌至 30 日均线下方

read.en: AMD fell 5.7% on Oct 14 to $570.82 and is down 12% in five sessions. It is below its 5-day ($599.9) and 10-day ($617.6) averages and just under the rising 30-day ($572.3), while staying above the 100-day ($524.5) and 200-day ($391.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 with a widening histogram, still above zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($645.0), and RSI is 47.
read.zh: AMD 10月14日下跌 5.7%，收于 $570.82，五个交易日下跌 12%。股价位于 5 日（$599.9）和 10 日均线（$617.6）下方，略低于上行的 30 日均线（$572.3），但仍在 100 日（$524.5）和 200 日均线（$391.0）上方。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方，柱状图扩大，仍在零轴之上；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$645.0），RSI 为 47。

read.en: The $588 late-September pivot broke and is now first resistance, with the 5-day average at $600 and the 10-day at $618 above it. The close sits on the $567–572 zone (30-day average, Oct 13–14 lows). Below it, support is $525 (August pivot and 100-day average), then $495–498 (late-June and early-July lows). A close below $567 would open $525.
read.zh: $588 的 9月下旬转折点失守，现转为第一阻力，其上为 $600 的 5 日均线和 $618 的 10 日均线。收盘位于 $567–572 区域（30 日均线、10月13–14日低点）。其下支撑为 $525（8月转折点及 100 日均线），其次 $495–498（6月下旬及 7月初低点）。若收盘跌破 $567，下一目标看 $525。
